company.name: CAMP4 Therapeutics
company.shortDescription: CAMP4 Therapeutics is a biotechnology company that uses RNA to restore healthy gene expression.
company.description: CAMP4 is focused on addressing the fundamental cause of disease by controlling the output of genes central to disease. By taking advantage of the gene circuitry code, CAMP4 is able to control gene production through signaling pathways the cell is already utilizing to regulate gene expression. Their predictions enables CAMP4 to have a rapid start to disease treatment, significantly reducing the time and risk to bring new medicines to patients.

aiResearchSummary.text: CAMP4 Therapeutics is engaged in developing methods to modulate gene transcription using antisense oligonucleotides targeting regulatory RNAs, as described in titles such as 'Modulation of syngap1 gene transcription using antisense oligonucleotides' and 'Modulation of gene transcription using antisense oligonucleotides targeting regulatory RNAs.' These approaches aim to increase expression of genes like SYNGAP1, Carbamoyl-phosphate synthetase, and Ornithine transcarbamylase, focusing on restoring healthy gene expression.
